description: This source file implements the BufferParser class and related classes for parsing media buffers, extracting media segment data, handling protection metadata, codec data, and specific parsing for audio and video buffers within a GStreamer-based media pipeline.

classes.name: BufferParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing media buffers and extracting media segment data, including protection metadata and codec data.

classes.name: AudioBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing audio-specific buffer data, extracting sample rate and channel count.

classes.name: VideoBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing video-specific buffer data, extracting width, height, and framerate.

methods.name: parseBuffer
methods.description: Main method to parse a GstSample and GstBuffer into a MediaSegment, extracting timestamp, duration, and media-specific data.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadataToSegment
methods.description: Adds encryption and protection metadata to a media segment based on buffer and structure information.

methods.name: addCodecDataToSegment
methods.description: Extracts codec data from GstStructure and attaches it to the media segment.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer
methods.description: Virtual method overridden in derived classes to parse media-specific data from GstStructure.
